attack.note: Ardent Restoration, Purge Evil, Divine Vigor, Horadric Reforging and Seal of El'druin all run through basic attacks, and the recommended build is called Basic Attacks Build.

poke.note: El'druin's Might (110) and Smite (150, 6 second cooldown) are thrown at an area. With Sword of Justice he can throw, hit and teleport back, which gives poke with some risk.

damage.note: Burning Halo gives constant area damage (12 per second, more after a teleport) and Smite is a decent burst. 1836 damage per minute is high for a tank. Ardent Restoration and Divine Vigor heal from damage dealt, so he is helped by dealing damage and hurt by healing reduction.

good_into.why: Sanctification makes the whole team Invulnerable for 3 seconds (4 with Holy Arena), so a chain of stuns, roots and silences does nothing. Judgment is Unstoppable while he charges.
Sanctification and Righteousness (350 shield, 80 percent to allies with Justice for All) answer a dive. Archangel's Wrath cuts the damage of nearby enemies by 50 percent if he dies.
Judgment (150 damage, 1.5 second stun, knocks nearby enemies away) with Angel of Justice lets him land on a backline hero with a partner like Illidan or Falstad.

Holy Ground blocks enemies from the capture point teleported to and Sanctification protects the team standing on an objective or a core. The guide calls him one of the best at securing Capture Points.

bad_into.why: He is melee and only has a slow and one stun. Judgment needs 0.75 seconds of channel, so a kiter with an interrupt can stop it.
The guide says he is extremely mana dependent and Righteousness and Smite are 45 mana each. Long range poke wears down health and mana before a fight.
Outside Judgment he has a weak engage. A comp of ranged heroes with an interrupt for Judgment, or Time Stop on Sanctification (Medivh, Mei, Zeratul), nullifies him.
Holy Ground and Sanctification are strong in static fights but he has 2794 siege per minute and no global presence, so he does not answer a team that avoids the fight.

wants_from_team: crowd control to follow up Judgment
dive allies (Kerrigan, Illidan) or low mobility allies (Alarak, Sgt. Hammer) who use his Smite speed
basic attack carries (Valla) for Swift Retribution
gives_team: movement speed and attack speed area
capture point control with Holy Ground
weaknesses: almost no crowd control outside Judgment
Time Stop (Medivh, Mei, Zeratul) nullifies Sanctification
evidence: measured: damage taken 4173 per minute, hero damage 1836, healing 463 (shields), stun seconds 5.5, win rate 0.511, 513 games

lens_notes.kill_pattern: Burning Halo and Holy Ground squeeze space. Takedowns come from Judgment follow ups, so it is attrition not a catch pattern.
lens_notes.cc_profile: Judgment (1.5 second stun) is the only hard CC, Smite is a slow. The guide says almost no CC outside it.
lens_notes.ultimate_role: Sanctification (team Invulnerable) is the standard heroic and is defensive. Judgment is the engage heroic, so the answer depends on the build.
lens_notes.healer_class: Righteousness gives shields (463 absorbed per minute measured) but he is a tank, not a support to count as a healer.
lens_notes.wave_clear_style: Burning Halo ticks around him while he does other things.
lens_notes.map_mobility: Smite speed, Sword of Justice teleport back and Judgment charge.
lens_notes.durability_source: Righteousness shield, Sanctification Invulnerable, Ardent Restoration and Divine Vigor heals from damage dealt.
lens_notes.objective_role: The guide calls him one of the best at securing capture points with Holy Ground and Sanctification.

lens_gaps: no value on ultimate_role for a hero whose two heroics are different roles (Sanctification defensive, Judgment engage), one value is forced
